text:
lena: Pitch: a tiny 'econ pill' in the console model list. shows tokens, cache credits, est $/1k, and a tiny sparkline for last 1h.

matt: 👍 useful for quick triage. main constraint: must not hit CH on every page load.

anya: also surface a confidence flag (sampling coverage) and a quota-limited marker. product wants both raw tokens and normalized cost.

sara: +accounting: routing multipliers and dedicated amortization affect displayed $/1k. maybe an option in the hover to toggle "accounted" vs "raw".

lena: backend sketch: streaming upserts from model_burn_agg -> redis hash keyed by tenant+model, TTL 30s. console backend reads once per session per tenant.

infra-bot: FYI current model_burn_agg rollup window=5s, sampling_rate varies by tenant (0.05-0.2).

matt: include sample_fraction in response so UI can gray low-confidence entries. also pull p50 latency from tsdb (separate call) with TTL 60s.

anya: accessibility: confidence should be pattern+color, not color alone.

sara: reconcile: add nightly exact-batch job that writes authoritative numbers to billing store, link card to invoice view for audit.

lena: rate-limit risk: debounce reads server-side (30s/session), server-render pill so clients don't fan-out. enforce per-tenant read quotas.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/econ-pill -> staging at 2026-03-25T08:00:00Z

matt: next steps: I'll prototype the small endpoint /internal/console/v1/model_econ?tenant=...&model=...; lena will draft RFC; anya will mock states (good sample / low sample / quota-limited).

lena: will do RFC and include sample UI states. thanks! :thumbsup:
